public_rationale: The technical achievements can be examined, but this universal superlative cannot be scored fairly as written. Depth could mean negotiation and strategic coordination; extent could mean task breadth or physical grounding. The sources document different forms of integration without a common ranking. Calling the statement true or false would require choosing the decisive dimensions and their weights for Marcus.
limitations: This does not dispute that Cicero represented a substantial technical achievement.
Earlier language-controlled robots are not automatically counterexamples to greater strategic or conversational depth.

our_interpretation: Built to date ends on November 25, 2022; later systems cannot refute this historical comparison.
Marvel is an expression of admiration.

No sufficiently stable plain reading determines what deepest and most extensive jointly mean across these different capabilities.
criteria.support_condition: Would require an independently justified comparison rule showing Cicero clearly ahead of all earlier relevant systems on both depth and extent; the statement supplies no such rule.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Would require an earlier system matching or exceeding Cicero under the same justified comparison rule; selecting one favorable dimension would not suffice.
